shoreline.observed_reefs_json: Mixed/disputed. Published 20-50 m salient; Blacka 2013 (p.98-100) reads it as a likely misreading (arbitrary dune reference line); Turner (2005) ~20 m accretion within 1000 m of the reef 2001-2003; shoreline receded 2.8 m/yr north/south and 4.3 m/yr in the lee over 8 yr (Blacka et al. 2008); sand increases mostly in offshore bars (City 2019). NSW review rating: coastal protection "Minor".
about 550,000 m3 of sand retained over the reef's first two years of operation (ABC News 2022); Watterson: compares favourably with nourishment over 30 years (journalistic, not a monitoring report)
